description: Version-matched code, corrected canonical program definitions, compact numerical results, environment records and provenance for Anatomical context reshapes sensory ganglion transcriptomic programs in diabetic peripheral neuropathy. This post-result correction and public-data extension preserves positive, negative and not-evaluable findings. Third-party source data are not redistributed.
